title: The Gingerbread Man
source: American folk tale (St. Nicholas Magazine, 1875, public domain). Original retelling.
moral: Running fast is fun, but home is the best place to be.

pages.text: Once upon a time, a little old woman baked a gingerbread man.
pages.caption: Baking a treat

pages.text: She gave him two currant eyes and a big smile. Then she popped him in the oven.
pages.caption: Eyes and a smile

pages.text: Ding! The oven door opened. Out jumped the gingerbread man! Hop, hop, hop!
pages.caption: Out he jumps

pages.text: "Run, run, as fast as you can! You can't catch me, I'm the gingerbread man!"
pages.caption: Run, run, run!

pages.text: The little old woman ran after him. The little old man ran after him too. Puff, puff!
pages.caption: Puff, puff!

pages.text: He ran past a cow. "Moo! Stop, little man!" But he did not stop.
pages.caption: Past the cow

pages.text: "Run, run, as fast as you can! You can't catch me, I'm the gingerbread man!"
pages.caption: Can't catch me!

pages.text: He ran past a horse. "Neigh! Stop, little man!" But he did not stop.
pages.caption: Past the horse

pages.text: He ran past a pig. "Oink! Stop, little man!" But he did not stop. Hop, hop, hop!
pages.caption: Past the pig

pages.text: Now everyone was running. The woman, the man, the cow, the horse, and the pig!
pages.caption: Everyone is running

pages.text: Then the gingerbread man came to a wide, wet river. Splash! He could not swim.
pages.caption: A wide river

pages.text: A sly fox sat by the water. "Hop on my tail," said the fox. "I will carry you over."
pages.caption: A sly fox

pages.text: The gingerbread man looked at the fox's sharp teeth. "No, thank you!" he said.
pages.caption: No, thank you!

pages.text: He turned around. "Run, run, as fast as you can!" And he ran all the way back home.
pages.caption: Running back home

pages.text: The little old woman gave him a hug. "You are quick," she said, "but you are safe now."
pages.caption: A warm hug

pages.text: And the gingerbread man sat on the windowsill, smiling, happy to be home. The end.
pages.caption: Home at last
